summary: Facebook Pages made in SoftWings can be attached: a brand without a Facebook profile shows Connect Facebook Page (chip and video tile), which saves a live Facebook profile and opens Meta's window. Every video has a Facebook tile. Instagram's wrong-account tile says 'Wrong account' with the detail in its tooltip.

spots.note: facebook with no profile: Connect Facebook Page
attachFacebook: saves a live Facebook profile, then connects it
Facebook tile on every video; fix routes Page connect to the brand page; Instagram 'Wrong account' short label
